summary: Frontend-only test of new 'Rekap per Kader' feature. Logged in as admin/admin123, clicked new sidebar item (data-testid admin-nav-rekap-kader), page rendered with data-testid rekap-kader-page. Table shows 11 rows (one per kader) with distinct 'Keluarga Ditangani' counts (Siti Aminah=5, Dewi Lestari=4, Rina/Nur/Sri/Maryam=3, Yuli/Fitri/Lestari=2, Endang=1, TEST_Kader_New=0) — confirming per-kader NOT aggregated. Three KPI cards visible (Jumlah Kader=11, Keluarga Ditangani unik=28, Kader Teratas=5) and horizontal bar chart 'Keluarga Ditangani per Kader' renders. Filters (start/end date, kelurahan, Terapkan button) work without errors.

issues: Recharts logs multiple 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on initial mount before container measures; charts still render correctly but warnings are noisy. Consider adding a fixed min-height/min-width or key prop to ResponsiveContainer to suppress.

critical_code_review_comments: Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on Rekap per Kader page — set explicit minWidth/minHeight to eliminate console noise.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rekap per Kader feature fully working. Only cosmetic Recharts warning remains. Backend endpoint /api/dashboard/rekap-kader was previously curl-verified by main agent.
